Example 1: Find covariance for following data set x = {2,5,6,8,9}, y = {4,3,7,5,6} Solution: Given data sets x = {2,5,6,8,9}, y = {4,3,7,5,6} and N = 5 Mean(x) = (2 + 5 + 6 + 8 + 9) / 5 = 30 / 5 = 6 Mean(y) = (4 + 3 +7 + 5 + 6) / 5 = 25 / 5 = 5 Sample covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N - 1) = [(2 - 6)(4 - 5) + (5 - 6)(3 - 5) + (6 - 6)(7 - 5) + (8 - 6)(5 - 5) + (9 - 6)(6 - 5)] / 5 - 1 = 4 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 3 / 4 = 9 / 4 = 2.25 Population covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N) = [(2 - 6)(4 - 5) + (5 - 6)(3 - 5) + (6 - 6)(7 - 5) + (8 - 6)(5 - 5) + (9 - 6)(6 - 5)] / 5 = 4 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 3 / = 9 / 5 = 1.8 Answer: The sample covariance is 2.25 and the population covariance is 1.8. Example 2: Using the covariance formula, find covariance for following data set x = {5,6,8,11,4,6}, y = {1,4,3,7,9,12}. Given data sets x = {5,6,8,11,4,6}, y = {1,4,3,7,9,12} and N = 6 Mean(x) = (5 + 6 + 8 + 11 + 4 + 6) / 6 = 40 / 6 = 6.67 Mean(y) = (1 + 4 + 3 + 7 + 9 + 12) / 6 = 36 / 6 = 6 Using sample covariance formula Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N - 1) = - 0.4 Population covariance Cov(x,y) = ∑(xi - x ) × (yi - y)/ (N) = - 0.33 Answer: The sample covariance is -0.4 and the population covariance is -0.33.
